title: DefinitionMergeContribution
description: Post payload of a Contribution posted onto the Definition panel with slot = Merge. A ReconciliationKS asserts that two or more prior Claim identityKeys describe the same GSM subject and should collapse onto one identity. This is identity-time merging, BEFORE Statement shaping. Granularity.Verdict (mergeWith) is post-statement consolidation; when both apply to the same identity, Granularity.Verdict wins because it is more informed (the resolved Granularity verdict supersedes the earlier Definition.Merge).

supersedesIdentityKeys.description: Prior identityKeys absorbed by this merge.
